variables.name: Node-RADS
variables.definition: Final recorded Node-RADS 1.0 grade, entered as a numeric ordinal value from 1 to 5

variables.name: Noncontrast attenuation
variables.definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal CT attenuation

variables.name: Contrast-enhanced attenuation
variables.definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal CT attenuation

variables.name: Noncontrast iodine concentration
variables.definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal iodine concentration

variables.name: Contrast-enhanced iodine concentration
variables.definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal iodine concentration

variables.name: Noncontrast effective atomic number
variables.definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal effective atomic number

variables.name: Contrast-enhanced effective atomic number
variables.definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal effective atomic number

variables.name: Noncontrast electron density
variables.definition: Recorded noncontrast nodal electron density as a percentage of water electron density

variables.name: Contrast-enhanced electron density
variables.definition: Recorded contrast-enhanced nodal electron density as a percentage of water electron density

variables.name: 70-keV attenuation
variables.definition: Recorded nodal attenuation in the 70-keV reconstruction

variables.name: 100-keV attenuation
variables.definition: Recorded nodal attenuation in the 100-keV reconstruction

variables.name: Calcium-suppression setting 30
variables.definition: Recorded nodal attenuation at manufacturer calcium-suppression setting 30; the setting is not a photon energy

variables.name: Calcium-suppression setting 70
variables.definition: Recorded nodal attenuation at manufacturer calcium-suppression setting 70; the setting is not a photon energy

variables.name: Short-axis diameter
variables.definition: Maximal axial short-axis diameter; primary eligibility requires >3 mm

variables.name: Long-axis diameter
variables.definition: Recorded axial long-axis diameter

variables.name: Attenuation increment
variables.definition: ce_ct - nc_ct

variables.name: Iodine increment
variables.definition: ce_iodine - nc_iodine

variables.name: 70-to-100-keV attenuation slope
variables.definition: (ct_70kev - ct_100kev) / 30

variables.name: Calcium-suppression difference
variables.definition: casupp_70 - casupp_30

variables.name: Arterial reference attenuation
variables.definition: Contrast-enhanced CT attenuation in the common carotid artery at the same level

variables.name: Muscle reference attenuation
variables.definition: Contrast-enhanced CT attenuation in erector spinae muscle at the same level

variables.name: Nodal-to-arterial attenuation ratio
variables.definition: ce_ct / ce_ct_artery; a zero denominator produces missing

variables.name: Nodal-to-muscle attenuation ratio
variables.definition: ce_ct / ce_ct_muscle; a zero denominator produces missing

note: These are 15 primary inputs plus eight secondary recorded or derived variables, not 23 derived predictors.
